# Context menus on darwin; enablement per state: disconnected, connected, running, busy
editor.context, for the query editor
  C&onnection >
    &Connect…  ++++
    &Disconnect  -+--
    Disconnect &All Queries  -++-
    ---
    C&hange Connection…  ++--
  ---
  E&xecute  F5  -+--
  Ca&ncel Executing Query  --+-
  ---
  Cu&t  ⌘X  ++++
  &Copy  ⌘C  ++++
  &Paste  ⌘V  ++++
  ---
  Comm&and Palette…  ⇧⌘P  ++++
documentTab.context, for a saved query's tab
  &Save  ⌘S  +++-
  Save &As…  ⇧⌘S  +++-
  ---
  &Close  ⌘W  ++--
  Close All &But This  +++-
  C&lose All  +++-
  ---
  Copy Full &Path  ++++
  Reveal in Finder  ++++
documentTab.context, for an unsaved query's tab
  &Save  ⌘S  +++-
  Save &As…  ⇧⌘S  +++-
  ---
  &Close  ⌘W  +++-
  Close All &But This  +++-
  C&lose All  +++-
  ---
  Copy Full &Path  ----
  Reveal in Finder  ----
dockTab.context, for a docked panel's tab
  &Float  ++++
  ---
  &Close  ++++
dockTab.context, for a floating panel's tab
  &Dock  ++++
  ---
  &Close  ++++
input.context, for a text field with selected text
  &Undo  ⌘Z  ++++
  &Redo  ⇧⌘Z  ----
  ---
  Cu&t  ⌘X  ++++
  &Copy  ⌘C  ++++
  &Paste  ⌘V  ++++
  &Delete  ⌦  ++++
  ---
  Select &All  ⌘A  ++++
